top25.name: threshold
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (the trigger size: the 99th percentile of the pair's previous 96 |z|, which today's |z| crossed)

top25.name: vol_48
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (mean absolute 30-minute step of the standardised spread over the last 48 bars)

top25.name: sigma
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (the spread's rolling sd (log-price units) at entry)

top25.name: sandwich
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (how far the spread's within-bar extreme ran past its close, in sigma, averaged over 96 bars)

top25.name: sigma_sym
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (spread sd over the 96-bar window using the entry bar's beta (leg-order symmetric))

top25.name: ps_efficiency
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (net move of the folded 1-minute spread over the last 60 minutes divided by the sum of the absolute 1-minute steps (1 = a straight line, near 0 = choppy))

top25.name: trig_sym
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (1 if the leg-order-symmetric |z| is above its own threshold and the previous bar was not above its own threshold)

top25.name: abs_beta
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (the size of the hedge ratio |beta|)

top25.name: rank90_idx_abs_ret_7d_seg
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (where the market index's absolute 7-day return sits against its previous 90 days (share of past samples below it))

top25.name: z_ratio
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (|leg-order-symmetric z| divided by |z|)

top25.name: ps_mins_since_big_step__isnan
top25.group: missing indicator of a G5 column
top25.meaning: when 1: LESS likely to revert (1 when ps_mins_since_big_step is missing (a sparse column))

top25.name: rank90_idx_rv_24h_seg
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (where the market index's 24-hour realised volatility sits against its previous 90 days)

top25.name: sign_beta
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (the sign of the hedge ratio beta)

top25.name: mins_since_trade_a
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (minutes since leg A last traded)

top25.name: n_other_triggers_same_bar
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (number of other triggers of the same unit on the same 30-minute bar)

top25.name: n_triggers_prev_24h
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (number of earlier triggers of the same unit in the previous 24 hours)

top25.name: ret_idx_7d__isnan
top25.group: missing indicator of a G9A column
top25.meaning: when 1: LESS likely to revert (1 when the market index's 7-day return is missing)

top25.name: mins_since_trade_b
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (minutes since leg B last traded)

top25.name: rv_btc_24h
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (BTC 24-hour realised volatility)

top25.name: threshold_sym
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (99th percentile of the leg-order-symmetric |z| over the previous 96 bars)

top25.name: sess_europe
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (1 during the European session (07-16 UTC))

top25.name: rv_eth_1h
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (ETH 1-hour realised volatility)

top25.name: corr_1m_24h
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (correlation of the two legs' 1-minute returns over 24 hours)

top25.name: vol_slope
top25.meaning: higher value: MORE likely to revert (sd of the last 16 spread steps over the sd of the 32 steps before)

top25.name: volratio_idx_seg
top25.meaning: higher value: LESS likely to revert (the market index's 24-hour volatility divided by its 7-day volatility, from 30-minute returns)
